review.posthog_relevance: Replay Vision feature implementation and UI responsiveness, including configuration, metrics, and usage tabs.
review.reason: The supplied observations indicate a mix of implementation and documentation changes. P1.F10, P1.F18, and P1.F19 contain JSX and CSS changes that demonstrate responsive wrapping and conditional display for the Replay Vision Scanner and related components, establishing a substantive, bounded capability. review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks complete implementation and backend/API changes, and several hunks are strictly CSS or story definitions, preventing a tier 2 or 3 assignment.
